order: task_names order, then original generated JSONL row order

generation.source_length: upstream length = cl100k token count(input + answer_prefix) + official output reservation; not Llama input L
generation.source_index: unmodified upstream index: niah uses first answer character offset; vt/fwe use source row index

prompt.note: Answers occur inside retrieval contexts by task definition; no separate gold answer is appended.

inference.stopping: natural model/tokenizer EOS or per-task max_new_tokens; no custom stop strings

scoring.prediction_cleanup: strip; replace each ASCII control U+0000..U+001F with LF; strip
scoring.per_row: mean(answer.lower() in cleaned_prediction.lower() for answer in answers), unrounded 0..1
scoring.task_aggregate: round(mean(per-row score)*100, 2), matching upstream task percentage

scope.purpose: representative 4-task corpus-free subset for exploratory local execution
scope.actual_llama_lengths: measure after model tokenizer load in runner; preserve cl100k source metadata separately
